# Lingopie

> > Lingopie is a language learning platform that teaches Spanish, French, Portuguese, Russian, Korean, Greek, and other languages through authentic TV shows, movies, and music with interactive subtitles.

The platform features Lingopie Music for learning through songs by artists like Bad Bunny, Anitta, ENHYPEN, and Angèle, alongside comprehensive blog content covering vocabulary, cultural traditions, translation tools, and entertainment recommendations across multiple languages.

## Key Topics

- Lingopie Music
- Language learning through TV and music
- Spanish learning
- French learning
- Russian language
- Portuguese (Brazilian)
- Korean (K-pop)
- Interactive dual subtitles
- Song lyrics learning
- Translation apps and tools
- Cultural vocabulary
- Latin music (Bad Bunny, Anitta)
- Cyrillic alphabet
- Beginner language guides
- Romance languages

## Language Learning Platforms

- [Learn Spanish with songs, music and lyrics | Lingopie](https://lingopie.com/music/learn-spanish-with-music): Learn Spanish through music featuring Bad Bunny and Latin artists
- [Learn French with songs, music and lyrics | Lingopie](https://lingopie.com/music/learn-french-with-music): Lingopie Music platform for learning French through songs and lyrics
- [Learn Portuguese with songs, music and lyrics | Lingopie](https://lingopie.com/music/learn-portuguese-with-music): Lingopie Music for Brazilian/Portuguese learning with Anitta and more
- [Learn Greek with real TV shows, Netflix and movies | Lingopie](https://lingopie.com/w/learn-greek): Learn Greek through TV shows with dual subtitles and instant translation
- [Urban | Lingopie](https://lingopie.com/music/playlist/Urban): Urban music playlist featuring Farruko and Latin reggaeton artists

## Spanish & Portuguese Language Resources

- [15 False Friends in Spanish and Portuguese You Can't Afford to Mix Up](https://lingopie.com/blog/15-false-friends-in-spanish-and-portuguese-you-cant-afford-to-mix-up): Compares Spanish-Portuguese false cognates in Romance languages
- [10 Famous Spanish Actresses In Hollywood To Watch Out For](https://lingopie.com/blog/great-spanish-actresses): Profiles 10 Spanish actresses in Hollywood including Salma Hayek
- [How to Watch Foreign TV in the USA [Ultimate 2026 Guide]](https://lingopie.com/blog/how-to-watch-foreign-tv-in-the-usa): Guide to streaming foreign TV via Sling, Univision, Telemundo in USA

## French & European Languages

- [Hobbies In French: 50+ Terms For Talking About Your Hobbies In French](https://lingopie.com/blog/hobbies-in-french): 50+ French vocabulary terms for hobbies and leisure activities
- [15 Dutch Jokes You Need To Understand When Learning Dutch](https://lingopie.com/blog/dutch-jokes): 15 Dutch jokes showcasing humor, wordplay and cultural vocabulary
- [17 Scouse Slang You Hear on TV](https://lingopie.com/blog/scouse-slang): Liverpool Scouse dialect and British English slang from Merseyside

## Russian Language Learning

## Asian Languages & K-pop Learning

- [Learn Korean With ENHYPEN: 5 Tracks Every ENGENE Should Study [Guide]](https://lingopie.com/blog/learn-korean-with-enhypen): K-pop guide to learning Korean through ENHYPEN songs on Lingopie Music
- [Japanese Culture Day: A Celebration of Tradition and Heritage](https://lingopie.com/blog/japanese-culture-day): Explores Bunka no Hi Japanese holiday celebrated November 3rd

## Turkish & Polish Language Guides

- [How To Say Happy New Year In Turkish? 6 Easy Phrases And Vocabulary](https://lingopie.com/blog/happy-new-year-in-turkish): Turkish New Year phrases and cultural traditions vocabulary guide
